newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Adtran cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Adtran cut to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Wednesday it reduced its rating on Adtran Inc to hold from a buy.

-- He also cut its earnings estiamtes for Adtran for 1997 to $1.09 a share from $1.20 and for 1998 to $1.46 a share from $1.55. Second quarter 1997 estimates were reduced to $0.22 a share from $0.28, third quarter to $0.29 from $0.32 and fourth quarter to $0.33 from $0.35.

-- Dain said earnings estimates were cut to reflect a more difficult environment for Adtran products, including HDSL (high-bit-rate digital subscriber line) and ISDN (integrated services digital network), both of which are used for high-speed Internet connection.
